name: Grilled Chicken
description: Seasoned grilled chicken, perfect with rice and salad.
steps: Place the chicken in a bowl.
Add the garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Let it marinate for 10 minutes.
Grill the chicken until fully cooked.
Serve with rice or salad.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Simple pasta with tomato sauce and ground meat.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Heat the oil and cook the onion with the meat.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
Mix the sauce with the spaghetti and serve.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: A comforting soup made with everyday vegetables.
steps: Wash and cut the vegetables.
Put the vegetables and water in a pot.
Add the oil and salt.
Boil until the vegetables are soft.
Blend the soup if you prefer, then serve.

name: Easy Pancakes
description: Soft pancakes for a special breakfast.
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Add the egg and milk and mix until smooth.
Heat a lightly greased frying pan.
Pour small amounts of batter into the pan.
Flip when bubbles appear and cook the other side.

name: Tuna Salad
description: A fresh, quick salad for a light meal.
steps: Wash the vegetables well.
Cut the tomato and cucumber.
Place the lettuce in a bowl.
Add the tuna and vegetables.
Season with olive oil and lemon juice, mix, and serve.

name: Chocolate Mousse
description: A creamy dessert for chocolate lovers.
steps: Melt the chocolate with the butter and let it cool slightly.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites.
Mix the yolks with the chocolate.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and add the sugar.
Fold the egg whites into the chocolate and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

name: Tomato Rice
description: Tasty rice cooked with tomatoes, onion, and herbs.
steps: Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Heat the oil and cook the onion.
Add the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Add the rice, water, and salt.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender.

name: Fruit Salad
description: A fresh and colorful dessert made with different fruits.
steps: Wash the fruit.
Peel the banana and orange.
Cut all the fruit into small pieces.
Put the fruit in a bowl.
Add the orange juice, mix, and serve chilled.

name: French Toast
description: Golden slices of bread dipped in egg and milk, perfect for breakfast.
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, sugar, and cinnamon.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture.
Heat the butter in a frying pan.
Cook the bread until golden on both sides.
Serve warm with fruit or honey.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: A quick and tasty rice dish with chicken, vegetables, and simple seasoning.
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Chop the carrot and onion.
Heat one tablespoon of oil and cook the chicken thoroughly.
Add the vegetables and cook until tender.
In another part of the pan, scramble the egg.
Add the cooked rice and remaining oil, mix everything, season, and serve.

name: Creamy Pumpkin Soup
description: A smooth and comforting pumpkin soup for a simple lunch or dinner.
steps: Peel and cut the pumpkin and potato into small pieces.
Chop the onion.
Heat the olive oil in a pot and cook the onion until soft.
Add the pumpkin, potato, and water or stock.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Blend until smooth, season to taste, and serve warm.

name: Avocado Tomato Salad
description: A fresh salad combining creamy avocado, juicy tomatoes, and lemon dressing.
steps: Wash the tomatoes and onion.
Cut the tomatoes and avocado into bite-sized pieces.
Slice the onion thinly.
Place everything in a bowl.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Mix gently and serve fresh.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Easy banana pancakes made with oats for a delicious breakfast.
steps: Mash the banana in a bowl.
Add the egg, oats, milk, and baking powder.
Mix until combined and let the batter rest for 2 minutes.
Heat the oil in a frying pan.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Cook on both sides until golden and serve warm.

name: Baked Fish with Lemon
description: Tender baked fish seasoned with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Place the fish fillets in a baking dish.
Mix the garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, herbs, salt, and pepper.
Pour the seasoning mixture over the fish.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the fish is fully cooked.
Serve with rice or vegetables.

name: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
description: A simple layered dessert with creamy yogurt, fresh strawberries, and crunchy granola.
steps: Wash and slice the strawberries.
Stir the honey into the yogurt.
Add a layer of yogurt to each serving glass.
Add a layer of strawberries and granola.
Repeat the layers until the glasses are filled.
Garnish with mint leaves if desired and serve.
